GCR runtime packages
====================

The standalone review worker bundles @gcr/client-contract, @gcr/client-core and
@gcr/client-executors 0.1.0-alpha.36 under Apache-2.0. Original notices and license
texts are retained in their package directories. Immutable source and artifact
provenance is recorded in vendor/gcr/0.1.0-alpha.36/ in the source repository.
